correctness.rationale: Definitions and quantifiers were reconstructed directly. The embedded exact verifier exhausts all target-size compatible subsets without timeout or heuristic pruning: six at size 11 and none at size 12. It directly checks every listed code, the 23-output shadow unions, the common core, the six-cycle, and the complete 12-element symmetry action. The proof is finite and claims no infinite extrapolation.
risks: The proof is computer-assisted; an implementation error is the main correctness risk. The verifier mitigates this with a definition-level shadow construction, a simple ordered exhaustive recursion, direct checking of every listed extremizer, and explicit symmetry traversal. Independent audit has not been performed.

It goes beyond the size invariant by determining all extremizers and their channel-symmetry orbit, with a concise common-core/six-cycle structure that can serve as a canonical benchmark for future constructions and exact searches. It is not an arbitrary slice or a mere table recomputation.
risks: The value is concentrated in one small finite parameter set; it is justified by completeness and structural classification, not by a claimed general theorem.
